name: Beat the Beast: Dragon's Wrath
review:
Beat the Beast: Dragon's Wrath is a 3x5, 9-line fantasy slot with majestic wilds and roaming wilds that move around the reels, plus a wild multiplier.

The bonus gives free spins, with retriggers unlocking the dragon's hoard. Thunderkick rates it Very High volatility, with an 11,111x cap and a 96.18% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
